    # Hold the reset pose, then close both hands around the cubes.
    target = np.empty(m.nu)
    for i in range(m.nu):
        jid = int(m.actuator_trnid[i, 0])

        target[i] = (d.qpos[m.jnt_qposadr[jid]]
                     if m.actuator_trntype[i] == 0 else 0.0)
    for off in (21, 41):
